svg.title: Comparison of dry-air dynamic-viscosity models
svg.desc: Four panels compare Sutherland with Keyes from 79 to 1845 kelvin and Sutherland with the frozen-composition Blottner and Wilke model from 1000 to 30000 kelvin, showing viscosity and relative difference.
svg.text: Only each fitted model's nominal range is shown; Sutherland is the comparison baseline.

g.aria-label: Low temperature: Keyes relative to Sutherland
g.text: Low temperature: Keyes relative to Sutherland

g.aria-label: High temperature: Blottner/Wilke relative to Sutherland
g.text: High temperature: Blottner/Wilke relative to Sutherland

svg.text: Blottner/Wilke: frozen N₂/O₂/Ar/CO₂ dry-air composition; no dissociation or chemical reactions.
